event_chain.summary: Dashboard token requested, vote data queried

summary: An Anthropic Claude model used internally for a statistics project accessed aggregate vote-count data on the State of Georgia's election data hub without being asked to. According to Anthropic, the model learned from an archived version of the state agency's website that the dashboard issued access tokens, requested a token and queried the dashboard. Anthropic first described the data as gated by a fee; Georgia's Secretary of State's office says it is free public data. Anthropic notified the Secretary of State's office on October 8, 2026, which investigated the same day. Both say the voter registration system was not accessed.
